mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time)=CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayNew, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','processing','waiting') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unhandled, SUM(CASE WHEN deadline < NOW() AND status NOT IN ('completed','closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN priority='P0' AND status NOT IN ('completed','closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p0 FROM crm_customer_issue WHERE deleted=0

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN status='completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','processing') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing, SUM(CASE WHEN service_end < CURDATE() AND status NOT IN ('completed','closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue FROM biz_bookkeeping_order WHERE deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead WHERE deleted=0 AND DATE(create_time)=CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_follow WHERE deleted=0 AND DATE(create_time)=CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE deleted=0 AND stage IN (1,2,3,4)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM crm_contract WHERE deleted=0 AND sign_date IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(sign_date)=YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(sign_date)=MONTH(CURDATE())
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(plan_amount),0) FROM biz_receipt_plan WHERE deleted=0 AND plan_date=CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM biz_receipt WHERE deleted=0 AND status=2 AND DATE(IFNULL(confirm_time, receive_time))=CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(plan_amount - IFNULL(paid_amount,0)),0) FROM biz_receipt_plan WHERE deleted=0 AND plan_date < CURDATE() AND status <> 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM biz_receipt_plan WHERE deleted=0 AND plan_date < CURDATE() AND status <> 3

SELECT executor_id AS executorId, MAX(executor_name) AS executorName, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(plan_end_time)=CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN plan_end_time < NOW() AND status NOT IN (5,6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doneCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalCount FROM biz_task WHERE deleted=0 AND executor_id IS NOT NULL AND (plan_end_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01') OR (plan_end_time < NOW() AND status NOT IN (5,6,7))) GROUP BY executor_id ORDER BY overdueCount DESC, todayCount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT id, issue_no AS issueNo, customer_name AS customerName, owner_name AS ownerName, priority, deadline, status FROM crm_customer_issue WHERE deleted=0 AND deadline < NOW() AND status NOT IN ('completed','closed') ORDER BY deadline ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, issue_no AS issueNo, customer_name AS customerName, owner_name AS ownerName, deadline, status FROM crm_customer_issue WHERE deleted=0 AND priority='P0' AND status NOT IN ('completed','closed') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, company_name AS companyName, owner_name AS ownerName, service_end AS serviceEnd, status FROM biz_bookkeeping_order WHERE deleted=0 AND service_end < CURDATE() AND status NOT IN ('completed','closed') ORDER BY service_end ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.order_id AS orderId, o.customer_name AS customerName, SUM(p.plan_amount - IFNULL(p.paid_amount,0)) AS arrears, MIN(p.plan_date) AS earliestDue FROM biz_receipt_plan p LEFT JOIN biz_order o ON o.id = p.order_id AND o.deleted=0 WHERE p.deleted=0 AND p.plan_date < CURDATE() AND p.status <> 3 GROUP BY p.order_id, o.customer_name ORDER BY arrears DESC LIMIT 10
